Eli said to her, “How long will you be drunk? Get rid of your wine!”

translations.web: Others, mocking, said, “They are filled with new wine.”
translations.bsb: But others mocked them and said, “They are drunk on new wine!”
translations.kjv: Others mocking said, These men are full of new wine.
